room.antechamber.title: Antechamber
room.antechamber.description: A dusty antechamber. Worn [flagstones](flagstones) lead north to a vault.
room.vault.title: Vault
room.vault.description: A low vault. Tiny holes pock the walls by the door.
detail.flagstones: Worn flagstones, scuffed by many feet.
detail.flagstones.found: One flagstone by the vault door sits a finger proud: a pressure plate.
detail.flagstones.disarmed: A wedge holds the pressure plate down; it will not fire again.
skill.disarm.label: Disarming
narration.search_floor: One flagstone by the vault door sits proud. A pressure plate.
narration.disarm_plate.success: You wedge the plate down. It will not fire again.
narration.disarm_plate.failure: The plate clicks under your fingers.
narration.poison.applied: A dart pricks your arm. Cold spreads from the wound.
narration.poison.tick: The poison burns in your veins.
narration.poison.expired: The poison fades from your blood.
